sessions.title: All is Forgotten
recap: You arrive to the city of V’eldrin upon the Sword Coast, the Drow Jewel of the North. Above you stretches the endless twilight beneath Auril’s Everlasting Darkness. No dawn breaks here. No warm sun rises in the east. The sky hangs forever in muted shades of blue, violet, and silver as it has for as long as anyone remembers. Darkness is normal. Daylight is myth.

You have been summoned by Highlord Jarlaxle Baenre himself who requested your assistance with a matter that he made clear was both delicate and profitable. There are disturbances beneath one of the old cemeteries and he wishes for capable hands to investigate. He hints more than once that there is something deeper at work here than missing people and opened graves, but gives little else away other than assuring you that your compensation will make the trouble worthwhile.

To guide you there, Jarlaxle assigns one of his assistants: a strange dwarven fellow named Athrogate. Equal parts charming and unsettling, he escorts you through the city and into one of the older graveyards where immediately something feels… wrong. The sounds of V’eldrin seem quieter here. The air heavier. The cemetery feels older than the city around it.
Eventually you arrive before the Hallix Mausoleum.
Athrogate wishes you good fortune, makes some excuse about having business elsewhere, and very quickly leaves.
Not suspicious at all.
Entering the mausoleum, you proceed quietly. Very extremely quietly. Without, ahem… a trace.
Inside you discover tombs and rows of sarcophagi. Many stand open.
There are no remains.

Moving deeper, you soon realize the dead have not remained where they were placed. Eyes from the grave watch your approach and before long creatures from the grave emerge to greet you. A battle ensues against a group of hungry wights and after surviving their cold touch and endless hunger, you continue onward.
Beyond lies another chamber lined with several doors.
Our rogue, having absolutely no troubles whatsoever, opens a padlock that appears to have been placed there recently.
Inside is not treasure.
Inside is an elven woman asleep in an empty coffin.
Her name is Sarcelle Malinosh.

She explains that she was taken from her home and brought here for questioning. She is one of the people you were sent to find. The others are Umberto Noblin, a gnome. Eldon Keyward. Indrina Lamsensettle, an actress. And if possible, Raina Kairls—a close friend of Jarlaxle who came to inspect the disturbances several days ago and never returned.
Sarcelle then reveals something stranger.
She says she carries a secret.

She sometimes experiences visions of another world. A world impossible to imagine. One where a brilliant shining orb hangs overhead for more than half the day. A world of bright blue skies and warmth. She spoke of these visions to someone and was brought here to determine where such impossible ideas were coming from.
But after telling you this… she suddenly seems confused.
She cannot remember what she was just saying.
Only that she had wanted to tell someone.
Finding this perhaps more disturbing than the graves themselves, you instruct Sarcelle to remain near the entrance where she can later be escorted safely back to Jarlaxle.
You continue your search and inspect two more chambers that appear to be storage rooms.
And there… our story pauses.
